# Installing Libraries and Initializing Data 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(nnet)
library(caret)
```

```{r}
test_data <- get(load("../data/test_data.RData"))
multiclass_logistic <- get(load("../data/multiclass-logistic-model.RData"))
colnames(preprocessed_winequality) <- c("fixed acidity", "volatile acidity",
                                        "citric acid", "residual sugar", 
                                        "chlorides", "free sulfur dioxide", 
                                        "total sulfur dioxide", "density", 
                                        "pH", "sulphates",
                                        "alcohol", "quality_group")
```

```{r}
test_x <- select(test_data, -quality_group)

test_y <- factor(
  test_data$quality_group,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2")
)
```

# Running Model on Test Data
```{r}
multiclass_logistic_predictions <- predict(multiclass_logistic, test_x)

multiclass_logistic_predictions <- factor(
  multiclass_logistic_predictions,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2")
)

multiclass_logistic_probs <- predict(multiclass_logistic, test_x, type = "probs")
results <- data.frame(actual = test_y, predicted = multiclass_logistic_predictions, multiclass_logistic_probs) %>%
  mutate(actual = case_when(actual == "0" ~ "poor",
                            actual == "1" ~ "average",
                            actual == "2" ~ "good"),
         predicted = case_when(predicted == "0" ~ "poor",
                               predicted == "1" ~ "average",
                               predicted == "2" ~ "good")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(actual, predicted), as.factor))
colnames(results) <- c("actual", "predicted", "predicted_prob_average", "predicted_prob_poor", "predicted_prob_good")
save(results, file = "../data/results.RData")
```

```{r}
head(results, 25)
```

# Model Evaluations
### Confusion Matrix
```{r}
# Confusion matrix for results plus one-to all metrics 
cm <- confusionMatrix(multiclass_logistic_predictions, test_y, mode = "everything")
cm
```

### Weighted, Macro, and Micro Averaging for Evaluation Metrics
```{r}
# Calculating macro and weighted average
# Macro average is just the average of the one to all metrics
# Weighted average takes adds the one-to-all metrics for each class and weights them by the portion of the data set that fall into that class
weight0 <- length(test_y[test_y == "0"])/length(test_y)
weight1 <- length(test_y[test_y == "1"])/length(test_y)
weight2 <- length(test_y[test_y == "2"])/length(test_y)
averaging_scores <- data.frame(t(cm$byClass)) %>%
  setNames(c("Poor", "Average", "Good")) %>%
  mutate(macro_average = (Poor+Average+Good)/3,
         weighted_average = weight0*Poor + weight1*Average + weight2*Good)

# Calculating micro averages for all metrics, the formula changes based on each metric so have to do it manually
# To calculate, if the formula for the evaluation metric for class i is a_i/b_i, then the micro average is sum(a_i)/sum(b_i) 
micro_sensitivity <- (cm$table[1,1]+cm$table[2,2]+cm$table[3,3])/length(test_y)
micro_specificity <- (sum(cm$table[-1,-1])+sum(cm$table[-2,-2])+sum(cm$table[-3,-3]))/(sum(cm$table[,-1])+sum(cm$table[,-2])+sum(cm$table[,-3]))
micro_pos_pred <- (cm$table[1,1]+cm$table[2,2]+cm$table[3,3])/ (sum(cm$table[1,])+sum(cm$table[2,])+sum(cm$table[3,]))
micro_neg_pred <- (sum(cm$table[-1,-1])+sum(cm$table[-2,-2])+sum(cm$table[-3,-3]))/ (sum(cm$table[-1,])+sum(cm$table[-2,])+sum(cm$table[-3,]))
# micro_precision and micro_recall are mathematically the same as previous metrics
micro_precision <- micro_pos_pred
micro_recall <- micro_sensitivity
micro_f1 <- (2 * micro_precision * micro_recall)/(micro_precision + micro_recall)
micro_prevalence <- 1/3
micro_detection_rate <- (cm$table[1,1]+cm$table[2,2]+cm$table[3,3]) / (3 * length(test_y))
micro_detection_prevalence <- (sum(cm$table[1,])+sum(cm$table[2,])+sum(cm$table[3,])) / (3 * length(test_y))
micro_balanced_accuracy <- (micro_sensitivity + micro_specificity) / 2

averaging_scores$micro_average <- c(micro_sensitivity,
                                    micro_specificity,
                                    micro_pos_pred,
                                    micro_neg_pred,
                                    micro_precision,
                                    micro_recall,
                                    micro_f1,
                                    micro_prevalence,
                                    micro_detection_rate,
                                    micro_detection_prevalence,
                                    micro_balanced_accuracy)
averaging_scores
```
